subject: Mediventures: Acceptance window rebase & contingency request
messages:
From: Claire Barnes <claire@mediventures.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@mediventures.com>, procurement@mediventures.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 12:12:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and eval windows (quick update)

Diego,

Quick heads up from our side — we ran into an internal scheduling conflict for the clinician evaluation window. Our compliance and clinical teams need an additional three weeks to run the device-integration checks; without that the acceptance window you quoted won't complete before our December board freeze.

High level:
- New preferred acceptance target: week of Jan 18 (was Dec 28).
- Procurement still wants to try to avoid re-running vendor scoring, but we may need a short addendum to the MAP.

Can you confirm whether the current MAP and eval plan can be shifted without losing the pilot discount? If not, I need a clear list of options we can present to leadership (credit, additional support days, or compressed acceptance plan).

Thanks — Claire

--
Claire Barnes | Head of Clinical Ops | Mediventures

Attachment: none referenced in-line
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
To: Claire Barnes <claire@mediventures.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and eval windows (quick update)

Claire — thanks for the update and for flagging the board freeze. Im sorry to hear the internal calendar forced this.

Short answer: we can shift the MAP/eval timeline, but there are three things to sort: pricing/discount guardrails, support coverage for the extended runway, and SOC2 evidence handoff timing. Ive attached a one-page rebaseline proposal and an updated MAP (v3) that shows the shifted milestones and our recommended checkpoints.

Options I recommend we present to leadership (high level):
- 10% one-time closing credit if you commit to the Jan 18 acceptance window (requires sales ops approval).
- No credit + 5 dedicated support days during the acceptance window (SLA-backed) to speed remediation.
- Maintain price/disc but compress the eval (two-week focused clinical pilot) — higher risk of late fixes.

Ive looped in Neha for operational detail and Ben for the finance/credit side. Please see attachments: Mediventures_MAP_v3.xlsx, Rebaseline-proposal.pdf.

Next steps: can you confirm by Friday 11/20 which option you want as the executive-facing recommendation? Well draft the addendum for Procurement.

Diego

--
Diego Fernandez | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Mediventures_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), Rebaseline-proposal.pdf (one-page)
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: Claire Barnes <claire@mediventures.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Re: MAP kickoff and eval windows (quick update)

Thanks Diego — reviewed the MAP_v3 and rebaseline PDF. A couple of operational notes I want captured for the risk log well share with Mediventures:

Risk log highlights (operational):
- Evaluation dependency: clinical data ingestion from Mediventures device firmware — current ETA for sanitized feed is Jan 4; if delayed, well push acceptance further.
- Support capacity: our Senior SE availability during Jan 18 week is low given other go-lives; to guarantee <200ms p95 latency for clinical routes we need to reserve two support days up-front or we offer on-demand escalation at higher hourly rates.
- Compliance handoff: SOC2 evidence will be delivered by Redwood on Dec 10 (stub attached). Mediventures procurement has asked for a bind that evidence will be in place before the pilot — we cant accelerate SOC artifacts beyond our security cadence.

Ask: Ben — can Sales Ops provision a conditional 10% credit that triggers on signed addendum (signed by both parties) and on acceptance no later than Jan 31? If not, propose the largest acceptable alternative (support days + limited credit).

Claire — Ill draft a consolidated MAP change log + risk table for your leadership; happy to join your exec call if helpful.

-Neha

--
Neha Kapoor | Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment referenced: SOC2-evidence-stub.txt
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Claire Barnes <claire@mediventures.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 15:41:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Re: MAP kickoff and eval windows (quick update)

Diego / Neha — quick finance stance: we can provision a conditional credit but with limits. Proposal from Sales Ops:

- Conditional credit: 7.5% one-time credit if (a) addendum is signed within 10 business days of this thread and (b) acceptance completes by Jan 31, 2027.
- If client needs acceptance window beyond Jan 31, we cant hold the pilot discount in perpetuity; alternative is a 3-day dedicated SE block (no additional charge) plus a 30-day price-hold.

Reasoning: credits require approval and are capped for this cohort. If you want to push a straight 10% we need an executive exception and must route for sign-off (2–3 business days).

Diego — I suggest we present both paths to Claire: (1) conditional 7.5% credit with tight addendum signature, (2) zero credit + 3-day SE block + 30-day price hold. Ask Claire which package her leadership prefers, and request Procurement to fast-track the signed addendum.

-Ben

--
Ben Carter | Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com

Subject: Mediventures decision / exec ask: acceptance window rebase (formal)

Claire / Samir / Procurement team — following our operational review and Sales Ops input, here are two formal packages for leadership review. Ive attached the updated MAP and the rebaseline proposal for inclusion in your briefing materials.

Option A (fast sign + incentive):
- 7.5% one-time closing credit (Sales Ops conditional)
- Conditions: signed addendum within 10 business days; acceptance completed by Jan 31, 2027

Option B (no credit):
- 3 dedicated Senior SE days during acceptance window (reserved) + 30-day price-hold for the rates quoted in the SOW

Operational notes / risk summary (short):
- If the clinical feed is later than Jan 4, we will almost certainly need to move acceptance beyond Jan 31. That will void Option A.
- SOC2 artifacts will be provided Dec 10; Procurement, please confirm this satisfies your evidence checklist or send the specific missing items by Dec 1 so we can prioritize.

Ask to Mediventures leadership: please confirm preferred option by COB Friday, Dec 4 so we can route the addendum and reserve engineering support. If you need an executive-level uplift to request a 10% credit, Diego can loop in our CRO but well need a short justification note from Mediventures procurement/leadership.

Happy to jump on a 20–30 minute call if you want to walk through the tradeoffs.

Thanks,
Diego
